Name: Seasonal Garden Farmhouse V2 (Unofficial Update)
Author: CyanFire
Description:
DustBeauty's Seasonal Garden Farmhouse V2 but with bugfixes, tweaks and improvements. This also incorporates [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15606]DLudi[/url]'s changes so a huge thanks to them also. I have fixed up a few layering issues, made it so more walls and floors are able to be decorated and it now optionally works for Cabins too!

Some areas might look slightly different than in the screenshots, this is intentional! The rooftop garden is accessible after the second upgrade through the attic now. Upgrading from the original mod may produce bugs, such as certain areas of flooring/walls not being able to be decorated. It is not recommended to install this mid-save at all. TMXL Loader may also cause bugs with the spouse room & stops the maps from loading because the game complains about re-ordered tilesheets. So it's recommended to not have it installed when using this mod. Multiple spouses are not supported as there is only space for one spouse room.
If using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22382]Farmhouse Lights[/url], set the "Cellar Fix" config option to false in that mod otherwise you will end up with a second cellar entrance in the middle of the kitchen with the second house upgrade.

It is recommended to remove all house renovations before installing this mod otherwise bugs will occur.


The mod now requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16507]Farmhouse Fixes[/url] with Unhardcoded Warps enabled for everything to work as expected.


As of version 1.7.11, I recommend backing up the SaveData folder inside the SeasonalGardenFarmhouseV2 folder. If this folder gets deleted you will lose the saved data for the Rooftop Garden for each Cabin in multiplayer. Also, if you use something like Upgrade Empty Cabins in single player to upgrade Cabins to the largest size.


I originally posted previous versions to the unofficial mod updates thread on the stardew forums but i've added it here for more exposure and for update notifications


Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17257]Permanent Cellar
[/url]
